title: B Make and report
text: You and your friends will also join Yang Ling this Saturday. Make a cleaning plan and report in class.
1 How can you keep Happy Tree Park clean? What's your plan?
I'll pick up rubbish and sweep the ground.
2 This Saturday, we'll clean Happy Tree Park. Liu Tao will pick up rubbish and sweep the ground. ...
What do you think of Yang Ling's idea of starting a cleaning group?
